evidence:
Caller (+60 11-5555 0100): Good afternoon, this is Inspector Faiz from Bukit Aman. Your passport number is linked to a money laundering case. Do not tell anyone or you will be arrested.
Caller: To prove your money is clean, move your savings to the Bank Negara safe account today. Account 1234567890123, name Ali Bin Hassan.
Me: I only have RM1,200 now.
Caller: That is enough. Transfer it now and send me the receipt.
Me: I have transferred RM1,200 at 14:32. Receipt sent.
Caller: Thank you. Wait for our officer to call you.

startedHow.value: A phone call from someone claiming to be a police inspector
startedHow.snippet: this is Inspector Faiz from Bukit Aman

followUp: Hi, I am Officer Daniel from the NSRC recovery unit. We can recover your RM1,200 but you must first pay a RM300 processing fee. Click https://nsrc-refund.example/claim to open your case.
